stimulus.inline: Pre-tax deductions like pension reduce taxable income.

items.question: Mr Mahlangu's gross is R15 500 and his pension contribution is R1 240. Calculate his TAXABLE income.
workingSteps: Taxable = Gross − pre-tax deductions = R15 500 − R1 240 = R14 260.

_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_DOCUMENT_FIELD: Reads the wrong row from a payslip.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_GROSS_VS_BASIC: Confuses basic salary with gross pay (gross = basic + allowances).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_NET_PAY_FORMULA: Net pay calculation is wrong (drops a deduction, or adds instead of subtracts).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_TAXABLE_INCOME: Treats gross pay as taxable income (ignores pre-tax deductions).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_UIF_CAP: Ignores the UIF cap and applies 1% to a gross above the ceiling.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_PERCENT_BASE_INVERTED: Uses the wrong base when finding what % deductions are of gross.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_ANNUALISATION: Mis-converts between monthly and annual figures.
